insights.summary: Invoca offline call conversions reach Google Ads one to three days after the call, so Smart Bidding optimizes on incomplete data.
insights.quote: The offline call conversions we send to Google Ads, they're showing up one to three days after the call. Sometimes three.

insights.summary: Front-line teams say AI call summaries save time on callbacks, dispatch and handoffs.
insights.quote: My managers read the summaries before callbacks and handoffs instead of pulling recordings. It saves them forty minutes a day, easy.

insights.summary: Customer links "offline conversions lag in google ads" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: And Diego, I'll be blunt, this one is on my radar for the renewal. If our conversions are lagging in Google Ads, we're paying for leads we can't read properly.
